When did you last clean yours? 

Extractor hood filters hold onto grease, grime and some pretty awful cooking smells 🤢 so they definitely need a good clean every so often!

And before anyone says “just put them in the dishwasher!” 😂 Not all filters are dishwasher-safe, and the dishwasher can tarnish some finishes.

I prefer cleaning mine like this with bicarb, or giving them a good soak in warm soapy water with a little white vinegar.

But come on… cleaning them like this is FAR more satisfying to watch! 😍✨

Be honest… when did you last clean yours? 

#queenofclean #amsr #satisfyingcleaning

Not sure who needs to hear this today, but…

✨ Wear the nice dress.

✨ Light the fancy candle.

✨ Wear the shorts & book the trip.

✨ Say no without explaining.

✨ Enjoy cleaning if that’s your thing.

Life isn’t a rehearsal. Stop saving everything for “one day” and start enjoying it today.

Which one did you need reminding of most? 💕👇🏻

#queenofclean #positivethinking #dailyreminders #enjoylife

QUEEN OF CLEAN’S BACK-TO-SCHOOL STAIN-BUSTING KIT ✨🎒

Don’t just get the school uniform ready… get your stain-busting kit ready too! 🙌

I’ve put together some of my favourite essentials to keep under the sink, ready to tackle those inevitable school stains. 🧼

From keeping white polo shirts looking pristine 🤍 to stopping black trousers from looking dull and faded 🖤 these simple tips will help keep that uniform looking fresher for longer.

Now tell me… 👇

Which tip is your favourite? And which one did you NOT already know? 👀

#backtoschool #stainremovers #laundryhacks

People are always assuming that Marks & Spencer is one of the most expensive supermarkets… so I thought I’d put it to the test! 👀

You all know how much I LOVE their cleaning products, but what about their everyday food? So I set myself a little challenge — 10 food staples for £10 🛒

Well… I smashed it 😂 12 items for just £9.35!

Honestly, I was shocked at how easy this was and these are proper everyday basics too!

Would you have guessed I’d get this much for under a tenner? 👀

M&S expensive… or actually pretty good value? 

Let me know below! 👇

#queenofclean #marksandspencerfood #budgetchallenge #under£10 #foodie @marksandspencerfood

STOP throwing all your dirty holiday clothes back into your suitcase! ✋🧳

This little packing cube trick makes coming home SO much easier 🙌

Before we leave, I use my packing cubes to sort all the dirty laundry into washing loads whites, darks, mixed colours and delicates.

Then when I get home there’s no huge suitcase of washing to sort through. Just unzip, empty and get those loads straight on! 🧺✨

Such a simple little holiday hack, but one that saves time when you’re already dealing with the post-holiday chaos!

Do you do this already, or are you stealing this one? 👀

#travelhack #unpacking #packingcubes

Outfits I wore on our mini break in Port de Sóller, Majorca ☀️🇪🇸

Which one is your fave? 👗✨

One thing I’m SO pleased about is that, now I’m in my 40s, I finally have the confidence to wear shorts. 🙌🏼

I avoided them for pretty much all of my 30s because I’d convinced myself I looked hideous in them. Looking back now, I just wish I’d appreciated my body a little more and worried a little less.

Why does it sometimes take us so long to appreciate what we have? ❤️

So here’s to wearing the shorts, wearing the outfit and not wasting another summer worrying about what anyone else thinks! 🩷

If you like any of the outfits featured, just comment LINK (affiliate) below and I’ll send all the details straight to your inbox 💌

And don’t forget to tell me your favourite — 1, 2, 3, 4…? 👇🏼

#fashion #over40fashion #queenofclean #mallorca #majorca

The reed diffuser hack everyone needs to know! 🤯🙌

Struggling to get that stubborn stopper out? Instead of reaching for a knife and risking your fingers, grab a corkscrew! 🍾

Twist it gently into the stopper and pull so much easier and a much safer option. 👏

Such a simple little hack, but one worth saving! 💗

#queenofclean #homehack #reeddiffuser

Everything in the garden is SO dry, so I’m making every drop count and using my leftover washing-up water on the hanging baskets and flower pots. 💦🌸

At this point, nothing is going down the drain if the plants can have it! 😂

MOTIVATION MONDAY 90’s style ✨

The biggest cleaning secret isn’t a product or fancy gadget… it’s consistency. 🙌

Little jobs. Every day. They all add up and stop the cleaning from becoming overwhelming.

Don’t aim for perfect just keep on top of the little things. 🧹✨

What’s your little job today? 👇

#motivationmonday #queenofclean #15minuteclean

KEEPING WHITE SOCKS WHITE🧦

I get SO many questions about keeping white socks white, getting rid of those grubby soles and bringing dull, grey socks back to life!
